description: This file defines the LoggerObjectRenderer class, an abstract class intended for rendering objects as strings within the log4php logging framework. It includes a factory method for creating instances of subclasses based on class names.

classes.name: LoggerObjectRenderer
classes.description: Abstract class for rendering objects as strings in the log4php framework, providing a factory method to instantiate subclasses.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates an instance of a subclass of LoggerObjectRenderer based on the class name provided, includes the class file if necessary.

methods.name: doRender
methods.description: Abstract method intended to render the given object as a string; to be implemented by subclasses.
